meta.title: Weights do not stop the vendor from bidding
gaps: Saving the happy-path weight cannot be expressed because no weight field or operation is provided.
The read-back fields do not expose whether the round remains weighted.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 100.
The invited QA vendor submits the bid.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds; “bid count” equals 1.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds; “bid count” equals 1.
